title: read-texts v1 (blob)
description: The text of the items of a stored read of one message: what `conversations.message_read` v1 points at in `texts` instead of carrying it. A blob (`application/vnd.campbooks.read-texts+json; version=1`) of the workspace, held by the message and deleted with it. The schedule module reads it to name the events it makes from the items; it holds titles and places and so appears nowhere in the event log.

quote.description: The sentence of the email that gave the date (a model read only).

ical_uid.description: The `UID` of the sender's own iCalendar event, when the item came from one.

asks.description: The words of the read's asks. Optional: absent when the read has none. The tasks module reads it to title the tasks it makes.
